result.topic_en: Calculations on symmetric biquadratic equations in x and y (Euler-type addition), forming resultant/discriminant expressions of quadratic polynomials with coefficients a_x, b_x, ... and a_y, b_y, ... and relations between products of such determinants.
result.transcription:
$a x^2 y^2 + b(xy^2+yx^2) + c(y^2+x^2) + dyx + e(y+x) + f = 0$ | $x^2(ay^2+by+c) + x(by^2+dy+e) + cy^2+ey+f$
$a_{x-y} x^2y^2 + b(xy^2+yx^2) + c(y^2+x^2) + dyx + e(y+x) + f = 0$

$\Pi\, a_{x+y}a_{x-y} x^4y^4 + (x^4y^3+x^3y^4)[a_{x+y}b_{x-y} + a_{x-y}b_{x+y}] + y^3x^3[2b_{x+y}b_{x-y} + a_{x+y}d_{x-y} + a_{x-y}d_{x+y}]$
$+(x^2y^4+y^2x^4)[b_{x+y}b_{x-y} + a_{x+y}c_{x-y} + a_{x-y}c_{x+y}] + (x^3y^2+x^2y^3)[a_{x+y}e_{x-y} + a_{x-y}e_{x+y} + b_{x+y}(d_{x-y} + c_{x-y})$
$+ b_{x-y}(d_{x+y} + c_{x+y})] + (x^4y+y^4x)[b_{x+y}c_{x-y} + c_{x+y}b_{x-y}] \ldots\ldots$

$a'x'^2 + b'x' + c' = 0$
$mx'^2 + nx' + p = 0$
$\sqrt{}(mc - ap)^2 = (bp - nc)(na - bm)$

$\Pi[(a_yc_x - a_xc_y)^2 - (a_xb_y - a_yb_x)(b_xc_y - b_yc_x)]$
$= \Pi a_{x+y} a_{\frac{x-y}{2}}$

$\Pi[(a_yy^2+b_yy+c_y)(c_xx^2+e_xx+f_x) - (a_xx^2+b_xx+c_x)(c_yy^2+e_yy+f_y)]$
$= [(a_xx^2+b_xx+c_x)(b_yy^2+d_yy+e_y) - (a_yy^2+b_yy+c_y)(b_xx^2+d_xx+e_x)] \times$
$[(b_xx^2+d_xx+e_x)(c_yy^2+e_yy+f_y) - (b_yy^2+d_yy+e_y)(c_xx^2+e_xx+f_x)]$
$x^4y^2 [(a_yc_x - a_xc_y)\cdot(c_xb_y - a_xe_y) - (a_xb_y - a_yb_x)(b_xe_y - c_xd_y) -$
$(b_xc_y - b_yc_x)(a_xd_y - b_xb_y)] = 2(a_xc_y - a_yc_x)(c_yb_x - a_ye_x) - (a_yb_x - a_xb_y)(b_ye_x - c_yd_x)$
$- (b_yc_x - b_xc_y)(a_yd_x - b_xb_y)$

$2(a_yc_x - a_xc_y)(c_xb_y + c_yb_x) - 2(a_yc_x - a_xc_y)(a_xe_y + a_ye_x) - (a_xb_y - a_yb_x)(b_xe_y + b_ye_x)$
$+(a_xb_y - a_yb_x)(c_xd_y + c_yd_x) + 2b_xb_y(b_xc_y - b_yc_x) - (a_xd_y + a_yd_x)(b_xc_y - b_yc_x) = 0$
[-$+2a_xc_xb_yd_y + a_xc_yb_yd_x - a_yc_xb_xd_y - 2a_yc_yb_xd_x - a_xb_xc_yd_y + a_yb_yc_xd_x$-]
$K\, x^4y^2 [(c_xb_y - a_xe_y)^2 + 2(a_yc_x - a_xc_y)(a_xe_y - b_xc_y) - (a_xd_y - b_xb_y)(b_xe_y - c_xd_y)$
$- (a_xe_y - b_xc_y)(b_xc_y - c_xb_y) - (a_xb_y - a_yb_x)(b_xf_y - e_yc_x)] = Kx^2y^4$

methods.what: Symmetric biquadratic relation in x,y written as quadratic in x
Product of two biquadratics expanded by powers of x,y
Resultant condition for two quadratics to share a root
Product of resultants expressed via leading coefficients
Elimination (Bezout/resultant) identity for quadratics in x and y, compared coefficientwise
Coefficient comparison of x^4y^2 term giving an identity among coefficients
